body:
A university research team has developed a new artificial intelligence method designed to improve the analysis of large scientific datasets.

The researchers said the method could reduce the time needed to process and analyze data, potentially helping scientists work more efficiently. They added that the approach may have applications across several scientific fields.

The team did not provide further details about the method or identify the specific areas of research where it could be used.
lead: A university research team has developed an artificial intelligence method that could help researchers analyze large scientific datasets more efficiently and reduce the time required for data analysis.
title: University Team Develops AI Method to Accelerate Scientific Data Analysis
